d: Svi Mykhailiuk put on a SHOOTING CLINIC, exploding for a career-high 39 points, 5 rebounds, 3 assists, and 10 three-pointers against the Dallas Mavericks. Svi caught fire from beyond the arc, recording the 2nd-most made threes in a single game in Utah Jazz history, trailing only Bojan Bogdanović's 11. He was especially UNSTOPPABLE in the 4th quarter, pouring in 23 points on 7-of-9 shooting and 6-of-7 from three! Mykhailiuk helped spark an incredible 18-point comeback, bringing the Jazz back from an 18-point deficit to tie the game, but Dallas ultimately came away with the win.
